facts.text: Jolene proposed a volunteer program where engineers teach STEM to underprivileged kids.

evidence.quote: Hey, speaking of helping out, I had an idea: a volunteer program where engineers teach STEM to underprivileged kids. What do you think of that?
That sounds great, Jolene! It's a great way to help and inspire others.

facts.text: Jolene mentioned considering teaming up with local schools and centers to conduct workshops.

evidence.quote: I'm thinking of teaming up with local schools/centers to do workshops.

facts.text: Jolene indicated that she had not yet reached out to any schools or centers.

evidence.quote: No, not yet. I want to solidify the plan first. Can't wait to start reaching out, though!

facts.text: Deborah suggested that having guest speakers, like engineers, would give kids a real-world view.

evidence.quote: Having guest speakers, like them, would definitely give the kids a real-world view.
